label: SLA panel
description: The record's service-level targets (for example response and resolution): time left or how late it is, whether the clock is paused, the goal and the business calendar it is measured in, and whether stopped targets were met or missed.
usage: Place it on a record view whose entity has an SLA policy, in the side column or a Service levels tab.
It shows nothing when no SLA policy applies to the record.
constraints: Visible to anyone who can read the record.
Deadlines come from the server; business hours, holidays and daylight-saving changes are applied there.

binding.description: Reads the SLA timers of the page's record.

accessibility.notes: Each target reads as a sentence, e.g. "Resolution: at risk, 1 h 20 min left"; the progress bar is a meter with its value.

examples.description: Service levels in the side column
